title: Reservation reminder
description: Remind diners about an upcoming reservation and ask them to confirm. Appointment reminder WhatsApp template for restaurants.
notes: Send 3 to 24 hours ahead. A confirm button gives you time to release tables that will not show.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, a reminder that your table for {{party_size}} at {{restaurant}} is today at {{time}}. Can we count on you?
